All four sheets read sighted; muse label-integrity 4/4 PASS; 96/96 deterministic gates PASS. Headline science: the n=9 data showed the opener grammar is BIMODAL, not a spectrum - held-cinematic openers 2.16-26.64s in 7/9 films vs fast logo-card openers <=0.7s in 2/9 (Nothing 0.68s, PS5 Pro 0.533s), with the 0.7-2.1s band EMPTY across all nine - and this also corrected R23's scoping (DJI opens in-world yet holds 4.2s, so 'in-world openers cut immediately' was wrong too). New grammar lanes discovered: DJI output-montage (the film IS the drone's footage, 0.39 cuts/s class high, product in ~2 of 40 sampled frames), PS5 Pro full-frame neon spec-card CGI (sat 0.625 class high), Switch 2 stacked-card ending (4 cards spanning the last ~42s) with LRA 18.6 doubling the prior class high.
